title: v5.7 gate. CTRL with the tool alone: T4's roster with packs of seven, cohesion on, ecology on. The first kangaroo group is held forty days by the console verb the pass it is seen and dismissed six passes (about 18,000 ticks) later; the first dingo pack's spread is read from units.tsv as in E28. Forty-five thousand ticks, two replicates. Pass: the coupled pack's mean spread under 8 with a leader named in the status line; the held kangaroos still on the map at the dismiss; after the dismiss they leave and the kangaroo pool entry returns to its start value (DF's own refund, v5.3); no unit on the same tile for 5,000 ticks.
fork: v5.7 ships: leader cohesion on the groups job, hold and dismiss through the console, refund exact, no stuck unit.

predictions.expects: pack spread under 8 mean with 'pack led by #' in the status; kangaroos present through the hold and gone within ~6,000 ticks of the dismiss; pool entry back to its start value; no stuck unit
held kangaroos leave anyway, or the entry is refunded twice, or a unit stands still 5,000 ticks

kill_criterion: all four checks in 2 of 2 ships v5.7; a stuck unit defines the sweep; a double refund reopens v5.3's rule
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: v57
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1 end end; local a,f=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); for _,t in ipairs({'COUGAR','DINGO','WOLF','BIRD_EMU','BADGER','WOMBAT','PORCUPINE','KANGAROO','GROUNDHOG','SKUNK'}) do cfg.assign[t]={0,1,2,3}; cfg.allow[t]=true end; cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=true; cfg.groups.pack=7; cfg.groups.cohesion=true; cfg.ecology.enabled=true; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('roster: allowed %d assigned %d thin %d applied %d; predators and prey in every season; groups on, coupling on, pack 7, cohesion on, ecology %s; rotation enabled'):format(n,a,f,act, tostring(true)))

local n=0; for i,p in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local cr=df.creature_raw.find(p.race); if p.type==df.world_population_type.Animal and cr and cr.creature_id=='KANGAROO' and p.population.region_x==29 and p.population.region_y==20 and p.population.feature_idx==-1 then print(('t5 pool: KANGAROO idx %d quantity %d'):format(i,p.quantity)); n=n+1 end end; if n==0 then print('t5 pool: no KANGAROO entry at 29,20') end

do: local st=dfhack.persistent.getSiteData('t5',{}); st.n=(st.n or 0)+1; dfhack.persistent.saveSiteData('t5',st); local g=dfhack.persistent.getSiteData('seasonal-wildlife/groups',{}); local kang=nil; for _,grp in ipairs(g.groups or {}) do if grp.token=='KANGAROO' then kang=grp end end; if kang and not st.held then st.held=st.n; dfhack.persistent.saveSiteData('t5',st); print('t5: '..dfhack.run_command_silent('seasonal-wildlife','groups','hold','KANGAROO','40')) elseif st.held and not st.dismissed and st.n>=st.held+6 then st.dismissed=st.n; dfhack.persistent.saveSiteData('t5',st); print('t5: '..dfhack.run_command_silent('seasonal-wildlife','groups','dismiss','KANGAROO')) else print(('t5: pass %d, held at %s, dismissed at %s'):format(st.n, tostring(st.held), tostring(st.dismissed))) end

local n=0; for i,p in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local cr=df.creature_raw.find(p.race); if p.type==df.world_population_type.Animal and cr and cr.creature_id=='KANGAROO' and p.population.region_x==29 and p.population.region_y==20 and p.population.feature_idx==-1 then print(('t5 pool: KANGAROO idx %d quantity %d'):format(i,p.quantity)); n=n+1 end end; if n==0 then print('t5 pool: no KANGAROO entry at 29,20') end
